mod.name: TB Real Estate
mod.summary: Players can buy houses and other buildings on the map, lock them with keys, add extensions such as alarms, extra storage and respawn points, and keep their items from disappearing. Other players can raid houses with the right tools, optionally only inside time windows.
mod.notes: The server needs storeHouseStateDisabled = 0 in serverDZ.cfg. Restart after every config change. SpawnPoint.json is documented but was not present in the sample folder.

files.title: Raid time windows
files.summary: Global switch and time windows in which houses can be raided.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

isInitialized.label: Initialised flag
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod once the file was created. Leave it as it is.

useUTCTime.label: Use UTC time
useUTCTime.help: 1 reads the raid times as UTC, 0 as the local time of the server machine. Matters when your host is in a different time zone than your players.

isEnabled.label: Raid windows active
isEnabled.help: 1 turns the time windows on, so raids are only possible inside them. 0 turns them off. The doc lists 1 as default; the generated file has 0.

raidTimes.label: Raid windows
raidTimes.help: List of windows. Each entry holds a start and an end time. In the generated file the start and end have random-looking names; the mod reads them as start and end.

raidTimes[].label: Window
raidTimes[].help: One raid window with a start and an end time.

raidTimes[].*.label: Start or end time
raidTimes[].*.help: A point in time with year, month, day, hour, minute and second.

raidTimes[].*.year.label: Year
raidTimes[].*.year.help: 0 repeats every year, a four digit year means that single year. For weekday rules use 1.

raidTimes[].*.month.label: Month
raidTimes[].*.month.help: 0 repeats every month, 1-12 means that month. For weekday rules use 1.

raidTimes[].*.day.label: Day
raidTimes[].*.day.help: 0 repeats daily, 1-31 means that day of the month. With year 1 and month 1, 0-6 means a weekday (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday).

raidTimes[].*.hour.label: Hour
raidTimes[].*.hour.help: Hour of the day, 24 hour clock.

files.title: House settings
files.summary: Global rules for buying houses, locking, raids, disappearing items and no-buy or buy-only areas.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

isInitialized.label: Initialised flag
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod once the file was created. Leave it as it is.

showMap.label: Show map in house menu
showMap.help: Shows the map inside the house menu.

howManyHousesCanPlayerBuy.label: Houses per player
howManyHousesCanPlayerBuy.help: How many houses one player can own at the same time.

stopDisappearingCheckIntervalInSeconds.label: Item protection check interval
stopDisappearingCheckIntervalInSeconds.help: How often the mod refreshes items in houses that have the stop-disappearing extension. Restart needed to apply.

playerCanRespawnInHouse.label: Respawn in house
playerCanRespawnInHouse.help: Allows the respawn extension, so owners can spawn in their house.

useBlackListedAreas.label: Use no-buy areas
useBlackListedAreas.help: Houses inside the blacklisted areas below cannot be bought. Do not combine with the buy-only areas.

useWhiteListedAreas.label: Use buy-only areas
useWhiteListedAreas.help: Houses can only be bought inside the whitelisted areas below. Do not combine with the no-buy areas.

notSoldHousesAreLocked.label: Unsold houses locked
notSoldHousesAreLocked.help: Houses nobody owns stay locked, so nobody can walk in. Applies outside the listed areas.

notSoldHousesInBlackListedAreasAreLocked.label: Unsold houses locked in no-buy areas
notSoldHousesInBlackListedAreasAreLocked.help: Unowned houses inside the no-buy areas stay locked.

notSoldHousesInWhiteListedAreasAreLocked.label: Unsold houses locked in buy-only areas
notSoldHousesInWhiteListedAreasAreLocked.help: Unowned houses inside the buy-only areas stay locked.

stopGlobalStopDisappearingCheck.label: Disable item protection
stopGlobalStopDisappearingCheck.help: Turns the background process that keeps house items from disappearing off. Items may then despawn by the normal lifetime.

inactiveDaysBeforePlayerDataWillDeleted.label: Delete inactive owners after
inactiveDaysBeforePlayerDataWillDeleted.help: Player data of players who have not been online for this many days is removed.
inactiveDaysBeforePlayerDataWillDeleted.risk: Their ownership data is lost for good.

closeDoorsAtServerRestartAfterSeconds.label: Close doors after restart
closeDoorsAtServerRestartAfterSeconds.help: Doors of houses are closed this many seconds after the server starts.

housesCanOnlyBeRaidWhenOwnerIsOnline.label: Raid only with owner online
housesCanOnlyBeRaidWhenOwnerIsOnline.help: When 1, a house can only be raided while its owner is online. Protects offline players.

blackListedAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate
blackListedAreas[].position[].help: One of X, Y, Z (in that order).

blackListedAreas[].position.label: Centre
blackListedAreas[].position.help: Centre as X, Y, Z map coordinates.

blackListedAreas[].radius.label: Radius
blackListedAreas[].radius.help: Size of the area around the centre.

blackListedAreas.label: No-buy areas
blackListedAreas.help: Circles on the map used for no-buy purchase rules.

whiteListedAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate
whiteListedAreas[].position[].help: One of X, Y, Z (in that order).

whiteListedAreas[].position.label: Centre
whiteListedAreas[].position.help: Centre as X, Y, Z map coordinates.

whiteListedAreas[].radius.label: Radius
whiteListedAreas[].radius.help: Size of the area around the centre.

whiteListedAreas.label: Buy-only areas
whiteListedAreas.help: Circles on the map used for buy-only purchase rules.

houseDefinitionNames[].label: Building class name
houseDefinitionNames[].help: Class name of one buildable/buyable building.

houseDefinitionNames.label: Buyable building types
houseDefinitionNames.help: Class names of the buildings that can be bought. For every name a file in HouseDefinitions is created with the prices and raid rules.

houseConfigs.label: House data (internal)
houseConfigs.help: Reserved for the mod. Do not edit.

blackListedObjectsForStopDisappearing.label: Items excluded from protection
blackListedObjectsForStopDisappearing.help: Item class names that are not protected from disappearing. Wildcards: *start, end*, or exact names.

files.title: House definition (one file per building)
files.summary: Price, raid rules, storage and key limits of one buyable building type. The file name is the building class name.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

isInitialized.label: Initialised flag
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod once the file was created. Leave it as it is.

houseType.label: Building class name
houseType.help: Class name of the building this file describes. Must match the file name.
houseType.risk: A wrong class name makes the file useless.

sellPrice.label: Sell price
sellPrice.help: What a player gets when giving up the house. Usually below the buy price.

currencyType.label: Currency
currencyType.help: Currency used for this house, as defined in the shared currency config.

storageBuyFactor.label: Storage price factor
storageBuyFactor.help: How much the price rises when a player buys storage upgrades. -1 turns it off.

raidTools[].label: Raid tool
raidTools[].help: Class name of a tool, for example Crowbar.

raidTools.label: Raid tools
raidTools.help: Items that can raid this house. The attacker needs only one of them.

inventoryItemsPerLevel.label: Slots per storage level
inventoryItemsPerLevel.help: Storage slots gained with each storage level.

maxHouseInventoryLevel.label: Max storage level
maxHouseInventoryLevel.help: Highest storage level a house can reach.

raidTimeInSeconds.label: Raid time per door
raidTimeInSeconds.help: How long breaking one door takes.

maxKeys.label: Max keys
maxKeys.help: How many keys can be given out for this house. -1 means unlimited. Counted per house.

raidCoolDownInSeconds.label: Raid cooldown
raidCoolDownInSeconds.help: Waiting time after a breach before the next raid is possible.

stopDisappearingRange.label: Item protection range
stopDisappearingRange.help: Radius around the house in which items are protected when the house has the stop-disappearing extension.

files.title: House extensions
files.summary: The upgrades players can buy for a house (alarm, storage, respawn, lock, item protection). Normally only prices are edited.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

isInitialized.label: Initialised flag
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod once the file was created. Leave it as it is.

extensions[].id.label: Extension id
extensions[].id.help: Identifier used internally. Never change it.

extensions[].type.label: Menu label
extensions[].type.help: Label shown in the menu, as a translation key. Changing it loses the translations.

extensions[].description.label: Description
extensions[].description.help: Text shown to the player, as a translation key. Changing it loses the translations.

extensions[].price.label: Price
extensions[].price.help: Cost of the extension. For storage extensions the price is multiplied by the storage price factor of the house.

extensions[].currencyType.label: Currency
extensions[].currencyType.help: Currency used, as defined in the shared currency config.

extensions[].isHouseAlarm.label: Is alarm
extensions[].isHouseAlarm.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isHouseInventory.label: Is storage
extensions[].isHouseInventory.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isSpawnPoint.label: Is spawn point
extensions[].isSpawnPoint.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isLockSystem.label: Is lock system
extensions[].isLockSystem.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isKeySpawnPoint.label: Is key spawn point
extensions[].isKeySpawnPoint.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isStopDisappearing.label: Is item protection
extensions[].isStopDisappearing.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].isAutoLookDoorExtension.label: Is auto lock doors
extensions[].isAutoLookDoorExtension.help: Marks the extension type. Do not change.

extensions[].message.label: Message
extensions[].message.help: System message text key. Do not change.

extensions[].level.label: Level
extensions[].level.help: Tier of the extension. Do not change.

extensions.label: Extensions
extensions.help: All extensions offered in the house menu. Edit prices and currency only.
